title: If you could automate one part of stock research forever, what would it be?
author: i_am_Axzel
selftext:
I've been thinking about how much time investors spend gathering and organizing information before they can actually analyze a company.

If you could automate just one part of your investing workflow forever, what would it be?

Some examples:

1. Reading annual reports

2. Tracking institutional buying/selling

3. Comparing quarterly results

4. Finding valuation changes

5. News summarization

6. Something else?

I'm curious where people spend the most time.
